The first stage. Groups and their homomorphisms, quotients and the isomorphism
theorems, then rings and modules, and finally representations of finite groups:
Schur's lemma, characters, and the orthogonality relations. The point of the
whole section is to arrive at Lie theory with the right reflexes.
